programme.title: Kufr
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar says we humans are so caught up in our personal lives that we don't realise the entire world is flooded with many problems. We talk about them for some time & then go back to our normal lives.

programme.title: Guncha
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar says our lives are moving so quickly that the destinations are being left far behind. In this fast-paced life we need to take breaks more often to enjoy the small moments of lives.

programme.title: Raat
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar says in olden times a qasid i.e. messenger used to deliver messages across villages. People used to deliver their messages to each other through these messengers which arose the essence of life.

programme.title: Tere Baghair
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar tells how the path of life can lead you to various destinations & explains minute details about human relations & human interactions. He says that the journey of life is different for all.

programme.title: Rail
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar explains how water can be associated with various aspects of life. It is sometimes used to explain depth, power & at times happiness as well.

programme.title: Sawal Jawab
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar says trees have been an integral part of mankind & suggests the use of tree to depict various aspects of life - exploitation, hibernation, bearing fruits of success, hope & companionship.

programme.title: Sharaab
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar says ustaad shayars usually despised prejudice, strong held traditions, superstitions in their couplets & wrote more about humanity, companionship, friendship & love in one's life.

programme.title: Awaaz
programme.desc: Javed Aktar compares life to a budding flower, he further says there are many elements that are waiting to prevent it from blossoming. We therefore must focus on how to protect it & help it grow beautifully.

programme.title: Zindagi
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar uses the analogy of Raat & Subah to explain the context of sensitive and emotional side of human beings. He says feelings of longing, stillness & pondering all come alive during the night.

programme.title: Dhanya Rahim
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar explains the expression of emotions in a wide range. He says people who do not overtly express their emotions, leave room for more interpretation, empathy and genuine compassion.

programme.title: Rahiman Nijman
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's doha "Rahiman Nijman" where he says, self-pity & soliciting for sympathy doesn?t get us anywhere. It is always wise to keep our troubles with ourself to not get ridiculed.

programme.title: Kahi Rahim

programme.title: Rahiman Priti

programme.title: Rahiman Dhaga Prem
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar says every human has some thoughts & expectations from life. He further says life is a formation of various elements & is full of ups & downs while death is a destruction of these elements.
